models_evaluated: Care4 clinical dashboard with AI-generated Motivational Interviewing quality feedback

links.outcome: Treatment efficiency, appointments attended, and MI quality versus standard supports
links.effect: AI-assisted group had more efficient delivery and fewer appointments attended, but a significant decrement in MI quality over time compared with standard support.
links.quote: There was also a significant decrement in MI quality over time in the AI-assisted group compared to the standard support group.

unlisted_practices: AI-generated feedback to therapists on Motivational Interviewing implementation quality to support treatment fidelity

links.outcome: Motivational interviewing implementation quality over time
links.effect: MI quality significantly decreased over time in the AI-assisted group compared with standard supports. No numerical effect estimate was reported.
links.quote: There was also a significant decrement in MI quality over time in the AI-assisted group compared to the standard support group.

unlisted_practices: Supplement standard therapist implementation supports with digitized facilitation resources, content-fidelity feedback, and AI-generated feedback on motivational interviewing quality.

links.effect: Therapists using the AI support prioritized efficiency over relational aspects, causing a significant decrement in MI quality.
links.quote: Feedback in focus groups indicated that therapists perceived a task-oriented mindset to be associated with receipt of the AI-assisted support package, leading therapists to prioritize efficiency over relational aspects of therapy.
